cases.name: Ivo Senn
cases.action: Set a cup on the table
cases.report: Heard a break before the cup reached the table.
cases.voice: Ivo Senn set down a cup. He reported a break before it touched the table. Only the handle was retained. For its time, see Mara Pell.

cases.name: Mara Pell
cases.report: Placed M01’s break at twelve; said M04 removed the clock’s hands.
cases.voice: Mara Pell wound Ivo Senn’s clock. She placed the break at twelve. The retained face has no hands. She said case four had removed them.

cases.name: Neri Vale
cases.report: Saw CUP-01 intact after the reported break.
cases.voice: Neri Vale closed a window. She reported seeing the cup intact after the break. Her sliver fits a window, but no submitted drawing shows which window.

cases.report: M04’s missing account leaves M02’s clock-hand claim uncorroborated.
cases.voice: Entry four is withheld. Its key is present. Mara’s account of the missing clock hands cannot be corroborated here.

cases.name: Sila Rook
cases.report: The recurring tick is the cabinet latch, not a clock.
cases.voice: Sila Rook sorted the keys. Key four opened this cabinet. The tick marking these entries is its latch, she reported, not the clock named in case two.

cases.name: Orin Fenn
cases.report: Heard the break through a receiver, later. Was not at the table.
cases.voice: Orin Fenn picked up the handle. He heard the break later, through a receiver. He had not been at the table. The directory had filed both reports as observations.
